text.description_html:
Omnia 2364, Modern Mortise Lockset With Skylab Lever

The Modern Mortise Skylab Lever Lockset is a minimalist mortise door entryset. It comes packaged with the Omnia #364 lever with modern rosette, deadbolt, mortise lock, and all the necessary strikes and mounting hardware. This Modern Mortise Lockset With Skylab Lever is suitable for 1-3/4 inch thick doors with 2-1/2 inch backsets of 2-3/4 inch backsets.

Features of the 2000 Series Modern Lever Mortise Lockset:

  • Keyway: Schlage "C"
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • UL Listed 3 Hour
  • ANSI A156.13.2005, Grade 1 Lock

Specifications for Omnia 2364 Mortise Lock with Modern Rose Lever:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Lever Rose Diameter: 2-9/16"
  • Lever Rose Projection: 3/8
  • Doors Thickness: Optional, 1-3/4" - 2-1/4" Thick Doors (Contact Us if doors are thicker)
  • Backset: 2-1/2" or 2-3/4"
    • 2-1⁄2” backset with 3-7⁄8” minimum stile
    • 2-3⁄4” backset with 4-1⁄2” minimum stile
  • Strike: Solid brass curved lip strike. 4-7⁄8” x 1-1⁄4” x lip 1-1⁄4” to center.
  • Omnia Mortise Lockset Dimensions and Specifications (PDF)

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Cylinder Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button; then opens by key outside, by lever inside. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside.
  • Panic Proof Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside. Turning inside lever will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.
  • Storeroom: Latchbolt operates by lever inside and by key outside. The outside lever is rigid. Auxiliary latchbolt deadlocks latchbolt.

Sold Individually
